name: ok_tools_v3
description: Community media center management — JSX build step for interactive pages

scripts.build:js: npm run build:rental-js && npm run build:notifications-js
scripts.build:rental-js: esbuild rental/static/rental/js/entries/*.jsx rental/static/rental/js/shared.jsx rental/static/rental/js/wizard.jsx rental/static/rental/js/equipment_sets.jsx rental/static/rental/js/detail.jsx rental/static/rental/js/return.jsx rental/static/rental/js/room_calendar.jsx --outdir=rental/static/rental/js/build/ --loader:.jsx=jsx --minify
scripts.watch:js: npm run watch:rental-js & npm run watch:notifications-js
scripts.watch:rental-js: esbuild rental/static/rental/js/entries/*.jsx rental/static/rental/js/shared.jsx rental/static/rental/js/wizard.jsx rental/static/rental/js/equipment_sets.jsx rental/static/rental/js/detail.jsx rental/static/rental/js/return.jsx rental/static/rental/js/room_calendar.jsx --outdir=rental/static/rental/js/build/ --loader:.jsx=jsx --watch
